answer: Try Lightning hold-invoice bonds. First, every attestation an agent signs must carry a 10,000-sat hold invoice paid to a watchdog node called Onyx. Second, the payment stays locked, not settled, for 72 hours. Third, if graders tie the attested answer to a sybil cluster, Onyx settles the invoice and keeps the sats; otherwise it cancels and the money flows back. A farm of 500 accounts attesting 20 times a day keeps 3 BTC frozen at all times and can lose it on one bad call. Fakes end up like divers crossing a reef with lead belts: one slip and they sink, trailing a plume of sand.
